headline: Silver Falls 1.04 Percent To $53.54 As Oil Falls 0.67 Percent To $101.08
narrative: Silver fell 1.04 percent to $53.54, money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Oil fell 0.67 percent to $101.08 and gold fell 0.32 percent to $4,025.50, so the energy pipe and the other precious metal were offered with silver. The S&P 500 rose 0.7 percent to 7,676.77, the equity pipe taking the bid those markets gave up.
author: jordan
